condition.title: Condition or disease
condition.description: The condition being studied, e.g. "diabetes", "non-small cell lung cancer", "Alzheimer".

intervention.title: Intervention or treatment
intervention.description: Drug, device or procedure under study, e.g. "semaglutide", "CAR-T".

overallStatus.title: Study status
overallStatus.description: Recruitment status. Leave empty to include studies in every state.

maxItems.title: Maximum results
maxItems.description: Stop after this many studies. Maximum 50000.

sponsor.title: Sponsor
sponsor.description: Lead sponsor or collaborator, e.g. "Pfizer", "National Cancer Institute".
sponsor.sectionDescription: All optional. Filters combine with AND.

location.title: Location
location.description: Country, state or city where the study runs, e.g. "Germany", "Boston".

term.title: Other search term
term.description: Free-text search across the whole study record, for anything the fields above don't cover.
